capabilities: convert selected Markdown tables to LaTeX array/tabular environments
strip inline-formula dollar signs inside cells
trigger conversion via ribbon icon or command palette
extras: README is in Chinese; manual installation only (download main.js and manifest.json from a GitHub release); the manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice.
problem: Obsidian renders Markdown tables and LaTeX separately, so there is no built-in way to put a table inside a MathJax block.
summary: Converter that turns a selected Markdown table into a LaTeX array/tabular environment for MathJax rendering.
